result.description:
Personal Care Assistant (NDIS)

Employer: HI FIVE COMMUNITY SERVICES PTY LTD
Location: WERRIBEE, Victoria 
Salary: $80000 per annum + superannuation
Employment Type: Full-time
Job Type: Permanent (38 hours Full-time)

About the Role
At HI FIVE Community Services, we believe support should feel personal, not just professional. We’re a close-knit team that genuinely cares about the people we work with, and we’re committed to helping individuals living with disabilities live life on their own terms with dignity, choice, and independence.
For us, it’s not just about providing services; it’s about building real relationships. We take the time to understand each participant their goals, their routines, and what matters most to them. Whether it’s supporting everyday activities, building confidence, or encouraging community participation, we stand beside our participants every step of the way.
Our approach is simple: treat people with respect, show up with compassion, and do the little things that make a big difference. At HI FIVE, we aim to create a warm and supportive environment where participants feel valued and our team feels proud of the impact they make every day.
Because at the heart of what we do is one belief everyone deserves the opportunity to live a full and meaningful life.
Key Responsibilities
•	Provide assistance with personal care including showering, grooming, dressing, toileting, and mobility while maintaining dignity and individual preferences 
•	Support participants to develop independence and life skills in line with their NDIS goals and daily routines 
•	Assist with light domestic duties such as meal preparation, cleaning, laundry, and shopping to maintain a safe living environment 
•	Facilitate community access by accompanying or transporting participants to social, recreational, or educational activities 
•	Monitor participants’ wellbeing and report any changes or concerns to supervisors or relevant health professionals 
•	Maintain accurate records of care, progress, and incidents in accordance with organisational and NDIS requirements 
•	Assist with rehabilitation activities, therapeutic exercises, and basic treatments under the guidance of allied health professionals 
•	Provide support to therapists during sessions and assist with medication administration where trained and authorised 
•	Ensure compliance with NDIS Practice Standards, workplace health and safety, and mandatory reporting obligations


Skills and Experience Required
•	Certificate III or higher in Aged Care, Individual Support, or equivalent
•	Minimum 12 months’ relevant work experience required Australia/Overseas
•	Current First Aid and CPR certificate
•	National Police Check and Working with Children Check (or willingness to obtain)
•	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
•	Ability to work independently and in a team
•	Empathy, patience, and a strong commitment to quality care

Desirable
•	Experience working with elderly clients or people with disabilities
•	Valid driver’s licence and access to a vehicle (for community care roles)
•	Multilingual abilities a plus
•	Ability to work various shifts including weekends and public holidays

What We Offer
•	Competitive salary and benefits
•	Supportive and inclusive team culture
•	Ongoing professional development and training
•	Opportunities for career advancement
•	Flexible working arrangements

How to Apply
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and suitability for the role.

Location: Balaklava, SA, 5461
Full-Time: Immediate start
Reports to: Manager
Job Title: Registered Nurse (NEC)
Salary range: $80,000 - $90,000 depending on skill level and work experience + superannuation
Job Closure date: 30 days from day posted.

About the Role
Our client is seeking an experienced and compassionate Registered Nurse to join their dedicated aged care team. This is a pivotal role where you will have the opportunity to make a profound difference in the lives of residents, helping them to live with dignity, independence, and wellbeing.
You will be an integral part of a supportive and respectful community environment, dedicated to delivering exceptional person-centred care. Your primary responsibilities will include the provision of safe and high-quality clinical care, comprehensive medication management, and the ongoing monitoring of residents' health conditions. You will provide hands-on nursing support that is thoughtfully tailored to meet the individual needs and preferences of each resident.
Your commitment to fostering a homely and nurturing atmosphere will be key to ensuring every individual receives the best possible support to maintain their health, comfort, and overall quality of life. If this seems like a good fit, please read below!

Key Responsibilities

• Provide high-quality, person-centred nursing care to elderly residents, especially those with complex and changing health conditions.
• Deliver clinical care such as medication administration, wound care, chronic disease management and palliative care, in line with best practice.
• Assist residents and their families to make informed decisions about their care, ensuring their wishes and preferences are respected.
• Respond promptly and professionally to any changes in residents’ conditions and to clinical emergencies.
• Work closely with residents, families, and the multidisciplinary care team to assess care needs and develop individualized aged care plans.
• Review and update care plans regularly to reflect changing health status and personal goals.
• Ensure all nursing activities, progress notes and observations are clearly and accurately documented according to policy and legislative requirements.
• Supervise and mentor Enrolled Nurses, Personal Care Workers and other support staff to ensure safe, effective, and compassionate care delivery.
• Provide clear clinical direction and guidance, fostering a positive and collaborative team environment.
• Support staff to develop their knowledge and skills in aged care best practice.
• Maintain a safe, supportive and homelike environment that promotes residents’ health, comfort, security and quality of life.
• Uphold residents’ privacy, dignity, cultural identity and individual choices always.
• Comply with all relevant aged care standards, policies and procedures to ensure the highest levels of care quality and safety.
• Participate in continuous quality improvement initiatives to enhance the resident experience.
• Take part in ongoing training and professional development to keep up to date with aged care best practices, policies and regulatory requirements.
• Actively contribute to a positive workplace culture focused on learning, respect and excellence in care.

Skills & Experience
• Current registration with AHPRA as a Registered Nurse.
• Minimum 1 year of practical nursing experience, ideally in residential or community aged care.
• NDIS Worker Screening Check (current or dated within five years).
• Fully vaccinated for influenza (annually) and COVID-19.
• Demonstrated understanding of the Aged Care Quality Standards and person-centred care principles.
• Strong teamwork and leadership skills, with excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
• Own reliable transport.
• Commitment to long-term employment in a caring, community-focused aged care setting.

Why Join Us?
Top-tier salary based on experience and skill level.
Premium facility and support provided.

Apply Now:
If you have a genuine passion for NEC Nursing and want to be part of a dedicated team making a positive impact in your community, we’d love to hear from you.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

About This Role:

Our client is a beloved artisan bakery renowned for its commitment to traditional baking techniques and high-quality, handcrafted products. With a passion for creating delicious, wholesome breads, pastries, and desserts, they take pride in using time-honoured methods and premium ingredients to deliver exceptional baked goods to their community.
We are seeking an enthusiastic and dedicated Commis Cook to join their dedicated kitchen team. In this role, you will provide essential support in the preparation and production of high-quality baked goods and kitchen items, while maintaining the highest standards of quality, consistency, and food safety. The ideal candidate will have a strong work ethic, a keen willingness to learn, and a passion for the culinary arts.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

Food Preparation & Kitchen Support:
· Assist in the preparation, measuring, and weighing of ingredients for breads, pastries, and other bakery items according to exact specifications.
· Perform basic food preparation tasks such as chopping, mixing, and shaping doughs under the guidance of senior kitchen staff.
· Support the monitoring of fermentation and proofing processes for optimal results.

Quality & Service Assistance:
· Help maintain consistent quality by following established recipes and procedures diligently.
· Assist with taste-testing preparations and ensure workstation is stocked and organised.
· Support the packaging and presentation of finished products as required.

Equipment & Workspace Maintenance:
· Conduct thorough cleaning and sanitizing of kitchen equipment, work areas, utensils, and baking trays to comply with health and safety regulations.
· Assist in the safe operation and basic maintenance of kitchen machinery and tools.
· Ensure proper storage of ingredients and adherence to stock rotation procedures.

Skills & Requirements:
· Proven 2 years’ full-time experience in related position, with a strong interest in baking/pastry. Bakery experience is highly advantageous.
· Relevant qualification in Commercial Cookery (Certificate III or above) is preferred.
· A foundational understanding of food preparation techniques and kitchen operations.
· Ability to work early mornings, weekends, and public holidays as required in a bakery environment.
· Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality food.
· Strong understanding of food safety standards (HACCP) and hygiene best practices.
· Physical stamina to stand for long periods and work in a fast-paced, hot environment.

If you are passionate about food, eager to learn traditional baking techniques, and thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we would love to hear from you! Apply now to be part of a team that takes pride in crafting exceptional products with care and expertise.

Please note: We are acting as the recruitment agent on behalf of our client, and the employer’s identity will be disclosed upon application.
